records.title: HFedMoE: Resource-aware Heterogeneous Federated Learning with Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: Primary text evaluates heterogeneous federated MoE training/resource allocation and convergence, not LLM serving or inference latency; the lineage match is only the broader adaptive-expert theme.

records.title: Crab: A Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore Runtime for Agent Sandboxes
records.reason: The runtime reduces/overlaps checkpoint-restore overhead for agent sandboxes, but does not optimize LLM token generation, KV memory, or serving throughput; the relevance is adjacent agent-runtime engineering.

records.title: MFTFormer: Meteorological-Frequency-Temporal Transformer with Block-Aligned Fusion for Traffic Flow Prediction
records.reason: The primary paper is a meteorological/temporal fusion model for traffic-flow forecasting; its evaluation concerns traffic prediction accuracy and contains no LLM inference or KV-cache method.

records.title: Nex-N1: Agentic Models Trained via a Unified Ecosystem for Large-Scale Environment Construction
records.reason: Nex-N1/NexAU primarily scale agent environment construction and train agent models; benchmark results are capability/quality focused, with no measured inference-cost or serving improvement despite a high-throughput runtime component.

records.title: PISanitizer: Preventing Prompt Injection to Long-Context LLMs via Prompt Sanitization
